Financial risk management of the Group is carried out based on guidelines established by its parent Group's finance department which
comes under the preview of the Board of Directors.
Parent company's finance department evaluates financial risk in close co - operation with the hotel operational units. The parent
company provides guidelines for overall risk management as well, covering specific areas such as credit risk ,liquidity risk ,interest rate
risk and foreign currency risk.
The Group has established guidelines for risk controlling procedures and for the use of financial instruments, including a clear
